name: Peking University
englishBachelors: Very limited. Yuanpei College is PKU's liberal-arts honours college but teaches principally in Chinese. The Yenching Academy is a one-year master's programme, not an undergraduate route. Most international undergraduates study in Mandarin.
note: A university on a classical lakeside campus in Beijing. Be clear about what is on offer: Yenching is postgraduate and Yuanpei is Chinese-medium, so PKU is realistically a Mandarin-language destination.
